title: American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. Announces First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call
summary: American Integrity Insurance Group, Inc. (NYSE: AII) (“American Integrity” or the “Company”), a Tampa-based property and casualty insurance holding company, today announced that it will release its first quarter 2026 results after the market close on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, and will host a conference call at 9:30 a.m. ET the following day, Wednesday, May 13, 2026. To participate in the call, register at https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/597233559?pwd=g0YDCsIj or dial +1 585 542 9983 (U.S. Local) or +1 833 461 5787 (U.S. Toll-Free), using Meeting ID: 597233559. A unique dial-in code will be provided upon registration. The conference call will also be webcast live on the Company’s investor relations website at https://investor.aii.com . A replay of the call will be available approximately two hours after the live call concludes and will remain accessible for one year at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/597233559 and on the Company’s investor relations website.
